method_note: FAST mode, one round. F-001 to F-020 reused from articles/2026-11-17-bali-wedding-packages/02-research-A.json and 02-research-B.json, renumbered; each keeps its ORIGINAL checked date and its original ID in source_ref. Live quotes replace em and en dashes with commas or hyphens.

facts.claim: Our packages page says: "Every package is fully curated: the venue, the ceremony setup, an on-the-ground planner, photography, and accommodation for you and your guests". FAQ adds: "Specific inclusions vary by resort and are sent through after you enquire".
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Own brand page. Always pair with 'inclusions vary by resort'.

facts.claim: Packages page inclusions table: Ceremony venue and styling, Dedicated planner and concierge, The couple's accommodation = 'Included in every package'; Photography = 'Included, or arranged at preferred rates'; Guest accommodation = 'Paid separately, usually at negotiated group rates'; Legal and documentation = 'Paid separately, destination-dependent'; Extras such as spa, excursions or additional events = 'Paid separately, on request'. FAQ adds flights are typically paid separately.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Best single source for 'what is and is not included'. The same page's list says guest travel is 'coordinated' and legal requirements 'handled'; that means arranged, not paid for (A F-002).

facts.claim: Bali properties in our nine-package edit: Akohara Buahan Village Retreat ('In the highlands above Ubud'), Regent Bali Canggu, The Apurva Kempinski Bali.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Akohara is the only villa-style property in the edit. No prices or guest numbers shown.

facts.claim: Bali destination page venues: Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings, Conrad Bali, AYANA Bali, Grand Hyatt Bali, Alila Villas Uluwatu, Jumeirah Bali, Samabe Bali Suites & Villas. Areas: Uluwatu (clifftop), Seminyak and Canggu (beachfront), Nusa Dua and Jimbaran (resort).
facts.use_note: Jumeirah Bali area conflict noted in A F-007.

facts.claim: Bali destination page costs include 'Private luxury villa: villa hire from around $1,500 per night; full estate events up to $40,000+'.
facts.use_note: A batch ruled the page's whole cost block unsourced and conflicting with our cost guide (F-008 'Do not use'). The villa line is the only villa price on our site; hold for Nic (N-03 / N-201).

facts.claim: Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings (Tabanan) listing: Resort Exclusivity up to 60 guests USD 28,000 (two-night buyout of all 25 units). IDR 10,000,000 refundable security deposit per event; music ends 10 PM for non-buyout events; fireworks need hotel approval and police and village permits. Capacity 150 seated.
facts.use_note: Re-read today in F-100 range. USD only; Nic signoff on any price.

facts.claim: Our 2026 cost guide (planner Nicky Almeida, 'All figures in USD'): hidden costs include banjar (local community) fees, generator hire, overtime, corkage, wet weather marquees, government taxes and service charges. Suppliers usually take 30-50% deposit, balance 30-60 days before. Premium venues book out 12-18 months ahead.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Bali Wedding Cost: The Complete 2026 Guide
facts.use_note: Own editorial quoting a third-party planner. Banjar fees are planner opinion; no official source for amounts (see F-200 range).

facts.claim: Concierge page describes 'Venue sourcing and planner recommendations', 'Guest travel and accommodation concierge', and states 'We are not a traditional wedding planner'. It discloses: 'When a client books with one of our partners, the partner may pay Wedded Wonderland a booking fee.'
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Destination Wedding Planner & Concierge
facts.use_note: CONFLICT: Bali page calls concierge 'complimentary'; concierge page sells it from US$5,500. Use 'free Discovery Call' only until Nic resolves (N-02).
